steps: Export cppcheck-opensource/cppcheck at e1b5791564c662c7dacbc62835f6abe5431aa00b with git archive into a fresh external build directory.
Build offline: unshare --user --map-current-user --net make -j3 CXXFLAGS="-O1 -DNDEBUG -ffile-prefix-map=$CPPCHECK_SOURCE=." CPPCHK_GLIBCXX_DEBUG= cppcheck
Export capstone-engine/capstone at ccd25ab39eea534afbb70cfb047310c5a9962553 into a fresh external build directory.

Build offline: CFLAGS="-O1 -ffile-prefix-map=$CAPSTONE_SOURCE=." unshare --user --map-current-user --net make -j2 CAPSTONE_ARCHS=x86 CAPSTONE_STATIC=yes CAPSTONE_SHARED=no CAPSTONE_BUILD_CORE_ONLY=yes

Build owned decoder from static-native-capstone-helper.txt: gcc -O2 -std=c11 -Werror -Wall -Wextra -I "$CAPSTONE_SOURCE/include" -x c "$HELPER" -x none "$CAPSTONE_SOURCE/libcapstone.a" -Wl,--build-id=none -o "$KIT/capstone-decoder"
Copy cppcheck and cfg/std.cfg into the kit, preserving the cfg subdirectory.
Copy the previously pinned Census Geth helper (SOURCE_AUDIT.md, purego build, SHA11ad...) and this host's pinned GNU objdump into kit/geth-header and kit/objdump.
Validate every kit file against static-native-pins.json before execution; a different build digest requires separately reviewed pins, not overriding the verifier.

From the NQC checkout: python -B -c "from pathlib import Path; from superhunter.product_static_native import run; from superhunter.safe_io import canonical; import sys; sys.stdout.buffer.write(canonical(run(Path(sys.argv[1]))))" "$KIT"
failed_preliminary_attempts: Capstone command-line CFLAGS override omitted include and default allocator defines; the final build used environment CFLAGS so upstream flags were retained.
